description: Fixed training participation, prior skill and follow-up wages for descriptive comparison and standardization.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: worker_id
columns.description: Worker identifier from 1 to 600; a row label, not an economic regressor.

columns.name: prior_skill
columns.description: Prior skill category measured before participation: 0 = lower, 1 = higher.

columns.name: hourly_wage
columns.description: Follow-up hourly earnings at one common date.
